# P07 checkpoint

Scope: MC04, MC25, MC27, MC34 within G17/G18. Approved plan:
`data/accounting-master/runs/20261003T024539-18803fb0/P07/approved-plan.json`.

Implemented: versioned SQLite adapter around actual P05 Engine; immutable nodes,
full run locks, transaction receipt/state/journal/measurement/lineage, dynamic
payment replay, evidence review states, P06 temporal selection, transitive
invalidations, preserved old views, representation migration and source hashing.
Production stochastic execution explicitly Unsupported. Added profile, tests
and executed-evidence checker. No prior release/controller files edited.

First P07 run passed 15 tests, including all 32 event boundaries and foreground
SIGKILL before/after commit. Added a subsequent guard against newly derived
reports reusing stale runs, and locked-payload replay verification. Prerequisite
P03–P06 tests and the full checker are running with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1.

Changed source/code/test files: scripts/company_persistence_v1.py,
scripts/check_accounting_p07.py, tests/test_accounting_p07.py,
docs/design/spec/review-persistence-profile-v1.md. Deliverables will be generated
only after checks pass.

Exact next check: inspect /tmp/accdsl-p07-checker.log, fix any failures, run the
required P07 command again after changes, verify recovery.json/result.md and
protected inventory. Checker arguments use the packet-approved plan and supplied
phase-entry pre-edit inventory; no execution-specific inventory was supplied.

Limits: one local writer; deterministic bounded P05 fixture; no claim of
arbitrary hardware durability, source truth, accounting validity, forecast skill
or human acceptance. Acceptance is pending independent review.
